name: @builderforce/device-auth
description: Device sign-in (RFC 8628) against the gateway's /api/auth/device/{code,token} endpoints, in one place: start a code pair, open the approval page, poll until the person decides (authorization_pending / slow_down / denied / expired), and yield the bfk_* editor key — plus the best-effort key revoke on sign-out. Shared by the Chrome extension (Rovr) and the VS Code extension, so the polling contract cannot drift between them. Host-neutral: fetch, the page opener and the clock are injected; no DOM, Node or editor globals.
